ImageDescription.value: Lunch box from Syria or Egypt, late 15th century. These boxes were used to carry food on long journeys or military expeditions. The cover turned upside down functioned as a plate, which was supported on the broader handle of the vessel. The addition of the lock served to keep the contents safe at a time when assassinations through poisoning were common. Benaki Museum of Islamic Art.
